methods: SHA-256 comparison across all 49 named PDFs, every evidence catalog, the deployed timeline assets and complete repository history
Page-count, normalized text, rendered-page sequence and perceptual-page comparison for every non-exact match
OCR on all 38 pages without sufficient embedded text; all 38 produced readable text and none required unresolved manual review
Metadata, submission ID, version, attachment-list and certification comparison for portal-report variants
Conservative retention of distinct inspections, agency correspondence and portal submissions while suppressing only verified copies or defective derivatives

decisions.name: Five net-new records
decisions.reason: The April 18, 2018 DEQ PFAS-source follow-up, July 30, 2018 HNF interim submission and the 2014, 2015 and 2017 N3862 on-site inspections were not present as complete records and were added.

decisions.name: HNJ-P0ZX-8AVDS version 1

decisions.name: J19915-1 effluent report
decisions.reason: The supplied 22-page copy is the previously verified derivative with cropped and overlapping pages 15-16. It remains suppressed in favor of the complete reconstructed copy already preserved by the timeline.

decisions.name: Companion N3862 inspections
decisions.reason: The three multi-page on-site inspections are not duplicates of the one-page full-compliance evaluations for the same dates. They were retained as landfill air-quality and operating context, not as PFAS sampling results.
